items.title: The benchmark where AIs have to lie to win (23 minute read)
items.snippet: Blood on the Clocktower is a social deception game. Watching AI play the game unveils a lot about how AI is progressing on a set of AI capabilities that no other benchmark gives clear visibility into. The game requires AI to execute schemes with creativity, on-the-spot bluffing, and collective reasoning. This post looks at what happens when you pit AI models against each other in the game.

items.title: How Primary Compute Markets Work (7 minute read)
items.snippet: GPU providers sell capacity through reservations, on-demand rentals, and interruptible spot contracts. Reservations help secure financing through predictable revenue, on-demand offers flexibility at higher rates, and spot monetizes idle capacity. Ornn's compute price indices track executed on-demand transactions, excluding reservations and spot rentals.
